walkthroughs.body_html:
Cosmic microwave background: leftover heat from the early universe.

Predicted by Big Bang model; discovered in 1965.

Galaxies rotate too fast for visible mass -> dark matter.

Expansion is accelerating -> dark energy.

Period of 24 hours so they appear to stay above one point.

Used for communications and TV.
